SELECT c.id, c.platform, c.external_card_id, c.card_name, c.masked_pan, c.card_status, c.balance, c.currency, c.advertisement_account_id, c.company_entity, c.daily_limit, c.monthly_limit, c.transaction_min_amount, c.transaction_max_amount, c.utilization_limit_amount, c.utilization_limit_preset, c.period_max_consume_amount, c.provider_created_at, c.provider_updated_at, c.created_at, c.updated_at FROM card_station_card c WHERE c.platform = #{platform} AND c.external_card_id = #{cardId} AND c.deleted_at = 0
SELECT product_code, currency, balance, frozen_balance FROM card_station_balance WHERE platform = #{platform} AND deleted_at = 0 ORDER BY product_code, currency

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(card_status) IN ('active', 'normal') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active, SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(card_status) IN ('frozen', 'freeze') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS frozen, COALESCE(SUM(balance), 0) AS balance FROM card_station_card WHERE platform = #{platform} AND deleted_at = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE card_station_card SET daily_limit = CASE WHEN #{preset} = 'daily' THEN #{amount} ELSE daily_limit END, monthly_limit = CASE WHEN #{preset} = 'monthly' THEN #{amount} ELSE monthly_limit END, utilization_limit_amount = #{amount}, utilization_limit_preset = #{preset} WHERE platform = #{platform} AND external_card_id = #{cardId} AND deleted_at = 0
UPDATE card_station_card SET card_status = #{status} WHERE platform = #{platform} AND external_card_id = #{cardId} AND deleted_at = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO card_station_limit_record (platform, external_card_id, old_amount, new_amount, preset, status, created_by) VALUES (#{platform}, #{cardId}, #{oldAmount}, #{newAmount}, #{preset}, 0, #{createdBy})
mapper.select: SELECT id, external_card_id, old_amount, new_amount, preset, status, error_message, created_at FROM card_station_limit_record WHERE platform = #{platform} AND external_card_id = #{cardId} AND deleted_at = 0 ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM card_station_limit_record WHERE platform = #{platform} AND external_card_id = #{cardId} AND deleted_at = 0
SELECT id, daily_period, adjust_amount, min_amount, auto_adjust_enabled, updated_by, created_at, updated_at FROM card_station_limit_rule WHERE scope_key = 'global' AND deleted_at = 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO card_station_limit_rule (scope_key, daily_period, adjust_amount, min_amount, auto_adjust_enabled, updated_by) VALUES ('global', #{dailyPeriod}, #{adjustAmount}, #{minAmount}, #{autoAdjustEnabled}, #{updatedBy}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE daily_period = VALUES(daily_period), adjust_amount = VALUES(adjust_amount), min_amount = VALUES(min_amount), auto_adjust_enabled = VALUES(auto_adjust_enabled), updated_by = VALUES(updated_by)

INSERT INTO external_sync_job (provider, job_type, business_id, request_payload, status, requested_by) VALUES (#{provider}, #{jobType}, #{businessId}, CAST(#{requestPayload} AS JSON), 0, #{requestedBy})
